long_biography.plain_text:
At the Viersprong estate in Halsteren, Jan Wieger van der Linden opted for long leases after buying the property in 2016. Existing care organisations remained tenants, while he sought further occupiers for buildings becoming available. Residential redevelopment was only a possibility: the planning rules then in force did not permit it.

His restaurant investments also involved preserving established businesses. In 2022, he and Roeland Voerman acquired Old Dutch in Rotterdam, keeping the existing management and staff in place. Their proposed improvements were intended to retain the restaurant's character. The seller's daughter and son-in-law continued to run it, maintaining a connection with the family that had managed the restaurant for decades.
